name: Role Model / Hermit
life_theme: Three-phase development toward becoming a trusted role model, needing significant private development time.
work_pattern: Strong need for solitude to develop natural gifts. The role model quality emerges gradually — by mid-career, others begin to look to the 6/2 as someone who has 'figured it out'. Embodied living is the teaching.
career_approach: Honour the need for private development without apology. Opportunities come through recognition of natural talent. By mid-career, start consciously developing the values and lifestyle you want to model for others.
growth_edge: Not retreating into solitude so completely that the invitation to contribute never comes.
